title: Deployments
description: Releases of the connected repository, what is live, and the history of every deployment. A deployment is always a release tag and needs a second person.
refreshing: This page refreshes by itself while a deployment is running.

config.title: The connection to GitHub is not configured
config.body: The console deploys from one private GitHub repository through a GitHub App. The operator must set these server environment variables (in the secret store, never in the repository):
config.steps: The steps are in docs/build/14-deploy-runbook.md, section "Before the first deployment". Nothing can be deployed from here until this is done.
config.recordToken: DEPLOY_RECORD_TOKEN is not set (or is shorter than 32 characters). The pipeline cannot report its progress, so a deployment would be refused at its first step.
config.githubDown: GitHub could not be reached or refused the request. The history below is still accurate; releases and commits cannot be shown right now.

live.title: Live release
live.none: No deployment has been made from the console yet
live.noneBody: The first deployment recorded here becomes the live release.
live.mismatch: The server reports a different version than the last successful deployment. Check the deployment history and the hosting before deploying again.

active.title: Deployment in progress
active.body: Release {tag} is being deployed. No other deployment, emergency deployment or rollback can start until it ends.
active.waiting: Approved. Waiting for the pipeline to start.
active.abandonTitle: Close a deployment that stopped reporting
active.abandonBody: Use this only when the pipeline died and will not report again (possible 90 minutes after its last message). It changes the record only — check the hosting first to see which release is really running.
active.abandoned: The deployment was closed as failed.

events.rolled_back: Rolled back to the previous release

pending.title: Waiting for a second person
pending.singleOperator: Only one person holds a staff role, so nobody can approve. The request stays queued with no effect.

releases.title: Releases
releases.noneBody: Releases are annotated tags named vX.Y.Z, cut from the protected main branch.

candidate.title: Release {tag}
candidate.commitsNone: No commits between the live release and this one.
candidate.firstDeploy: There is no live release to compare with: this would be the first deployment recorded here.
candidate.ciRefused: This release cannot be deployed: CI has not passed on its commit. Fix the problem and cut a new release.
candidate.noRole: Deployments are requested by a platform admin or a security administrator.

request.reason: Why this release is deployed now
request.reasonHint: The second person reads this before approving.
request.requested: Requested. A second person must approve it —

emergency.title: Emergency deployment of {tag}
emergency.body: For an urgent security fix only. It starts at once, without a second person, and is marked as an emergency in the audit log together with your reason.
emergency.ciWarning: CI has not passed on this commit. Deploying anyway is recorded in the audit log as a CI bypass.
emergency.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. It is kept in the audit log.

rollback.title: Rollback
rollback.body: Sends production back to release {tag}. It switches the release only and never deletes data. If a migration made since then cannot be reversed, the rollback stops and says so.
rollback.none: There is no previous release to go back to. To change what is live, deploy a release.
rollback.reasonHint: One person may do this. The reason is kept in the audit log.

approvals.complianceAccess: Compliance access to the records of data subject {subject}, for {hours} hours

errors.notConfigured: The connection to GitHub is not configured on the server.
errors.badKey: The GitHub App key on the server cannot be used. The operator must check it.
errors.github: GitHub refused or failed the request (status {status}). Nothing was changed.
errors.notATag: A deployment is a release tag such as v1.4.0 that exists in the repository — never a branch or a commit.
errors.ciNotGreen: Release {tag} cannot be deployed: CI has not passed on its exact commit.
errors.running: A deployment is already in progress. Wait for it to end.
errors.alreadyRequested: Release {tag} already has a request waiting for approval.
errors.notRequested: This deployment request is no longer open.
errors.tagMoved: Tag {tag} no longer points at the commit that was requested. Make a new request.
errors.emergencyReason: Write the reason for the emergency (at least 10 characters).
errors.noPrevious: There is no previous release to roll back to.
errors.notActive: This deployment is not in progress.
errors.notStale: The pipeline may still be working. A deployment can be closed by hand only 90 minutes after its last message.
errors.notApproved: This deployment was not approved in the console for this release.

compliance.title: Compliance access
compliance.description: Access to one person's retained records for a legal reason, such as a data access request. It takes three people: the privacy owner asks and two other staff members approve. Access lasts a limited time and every read is written to the audit log.
compliance.threePeople: Requests are approved in Approvals by two people other than the requester.
compliance.singleOperator: Fewer than three people can take part right now, so a request would wait with no effect.

request.title: Request access
request.email: Email of the person the records are about
request.emailHint: The login email of their account.
request.reasonHint: For example: access request under GDPR art. 15, received on 03.02.2027. The approvers read this.
request.requested: Requested. Two other people must approve it —
request.ownerOnly: Only the privacy owner can request compliance access. You can see the requests and approve them in Approvals.

list.title: Requests and grants
list.none: No compliance access has been requested
list.subject: Data subject
list.exportHint: Account profile and the ids of the occasions it owns. The download is written to the audit log.

errors.reason: Write the legal reason (at least 10 characters).
errors.subjectNotFound: There is no account for this person.
errors.noGrant: You have no open compliance access to these records.
errors.notPending: This access request is no longer open.
